_comment: house_2 collision proxy (Blender frame, Z up; ws = 2.215 world m per raw unit). L-shaped: main ground body at the measured wall planes (x -0.73..0.79, y -0.855..0.79); the stone chimney column on the -X face as its own flush box (x -1.125..-0.70, y 0.135..0.565); the jettied upper floor + the +Y overhanging wing as one box (x -0.85..1.0, y -1.09..1.79), underside raised to 1.06 raw = 2.35 m world (the visible underside is 0.96 = 2.13, but the door-step probe below lifts the capsule head to 2.2 m, so the collision ceiling must clear that; the passage under the wing stays walkable); the thin wing support posts are dropped. Entrance: the arched door on the +X face with a single low stone kerb step (visible top ~0.11 m world - inside the engine's dead zone where an edge contact is neither walkable floor nor a step-up riser, and a 0.08 walk-over slab from analytic terrain does not lift either, so the collision step is a PROBE-mount box, top 0.1445 raw = 0.32 m world - treads under ~0.3 m world at a door-wall rest lose the wall-tangent support recovery and the capsule falls through - with the front extended to raw x 1.02 so the door-wall-stopped capsule stands fully ON the tread. Feet float ~21 cm over the low kerb at the door, the price of a mountable, standable entrance at this scale). Bases extend -0.3 below terrain.
